mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that increases voriconazole metabolism, reducing its antifungal efficacy, while voriconazole may inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism.
action: Monitor voriconazole efficacy closely; consider increasing voriconazole dose or selecting an alternative antifungal agent not affected by CYP3A4 induction (such as fluconazole or posaconazole with therapeutic drug monitoring).
